'''Customs''' was located at [[Tasariq City spaceport|the spaceport]] in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|Tasariq]]. It was an administration center and check point, manned by three [[Company/Legends|companies]] of the [[Tasariq Rangers]].<ref name="J15" />
